messages:
marta: little non-work update! accepted the Senior PM role today and were getting married in our backyard on Sept 18 🎉 also thinking of doing a tiny Redwood potluck beforehand — totally optional but would love to say thanks in person. no registry decided yet.
chris: massive congrats!!! 🎉 whens the pre-wedding redwood hangout? cake or cupcakes?
olivia: omg congrats marta!! thats amazing. i can bring empanadas or a salad. count me in for potluck.
zoe: yayyyy congratulations!! can we do a small card + group photo? id chip in for a gift.
aaron: congrats!!! ill bring folding tables + a speaker. also happy to help with setup.
people-ops: congrats marta!! we can cover a $100 team gift + card. ping us with address or an online wishlist if youd like us to handle it. :sparkles:
lunchbot: Poll: best time for a small Redwood meet before Sept? React with :one: for Aug 30 lunch, :two: for Sept 8 after-work, :three: for Sept 15 brunch
marta: thanks everyone ❤️ leaning toward Sept 8 after-work for a quick toast if thats the popular pick. partners welcome, will confirm headcount.
chris: RSVP Sept 8. bringing +1.
note: (reactions: :tada: x5, :heart: x3)
olivia: ill bring a gluten-free dessert and can collect messages for the card.
zoe: can someone make a tiny "Team Redwood" sign for pics? happy to craft it.
aaron: cake duty — classic chocolate or bakery run?
marta: chocolate sounds perfect. ill DM people-ops for gift coord and share address for cards. thanks yall, feeling very lucky and a bit surreal. coffee/hugs accepted. :blush:
